differences.what: composition: the arched pair at the front's south end, the round bay in the middle rising to a cone with a finial (a triangle in elevation), the door at the north end, the steep slated roof with a dormer at each end and the cornice's line; each lands within a few pixels of its place in the drawing
the front's width: the drawing draws it about 13.8 m across at its own scale (132 px), the 1911 sheet 13.0 m; the sheet is kept, so the render runs about 4 px inside the drawing at each end

the storeys: at the drawing's scale (9.58 px a metre from the cornice and the belts) the principal storey reads about 4.8 m and the chamber storey about 3.6 m where the record builds 4.3 and 4.35 m, so the chamber belt sits about 0.6 m low and the attic belt about 0.2 m high; the 1883 plate (album_1883) draws the same shape
the openings at the principal floor: the drawing's south pair has round heads under one arch and the door an arched head; built square-headed
the tower's lights: three a storey across the round bay, a broad centre light between two narrow ones; built two a storey
the dormers: drawn as crocketed wall dormers rising off the front at both ends with pinnacles and finials; built small gabled dormers in the slate

the stacks: the drawing's one tall stack stands just south of the cone, behind the south dormer (x 239-252 px of the copy), with a pinnacle at the front's south corner; the build's south stack stands at the front's south end. The photograph and the 1883 plate, both from the north-east, show no stack there, so this is the drawing's reading against theirs
colour and materials: the drawing is monochrome line work

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
